newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton prices fall on low demand, good supply.
newsitem.headline: India cotton prices fall on low demand, good supply.

text.p: Cotton prices fell on Tuesday on poor demand and increased supply, dealers said.
Arrivals in the Punjab region improved to 24/25 thousand bales (170 kg each) from 18/20 thousand bales, they said.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi fell by 15/20 rupees to 820/860 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned fell by 20/30 rupees to 1,420/1,630 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) lost 200/300 rupees to 17,800/18,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
Market sentiments were subdued at close of trade with limited enquiries from state-owned agencies, traders said.
